build_cumulative_group_norm: build a CumulativeGroupNorm module to normalize tensors with cumulative mean and variance along the time dimension
build_subsample_conv_projection: build a Gemma3nSubsampleConvProjection module to downsample mel-spectrograms by 4x and project to hidden size
test_cumulative_group_norm_forward: test the CumulativeGroupNorm forward pass with a batch of tensors shaped [B, T, F, C]
test_subsample_conv_projection_forward: test the Gemma3nSubsampleConvProjection forward pass with mel-spectrogram features shaped [B, T, 128]
review_subsample_conv_projection_padding: review the Gemma3nSubsampleConvProjection reverse-causal padding strategy for time and frequency dimensions
